_meta.note: Where people stand, work, eat and sleep in the vertical slice (Phase 3). All positions are reconstruction (C) unless stated; they are checked against the walkable grid by tests/people.test.ts. Phase 4 (session 2): masons camp moved N of the new Hall of 100 Columns portico; Treasury posts at the new N door; posts added at the Tachara, Hadish and Harem. Phase 5 (session 2): capital-carving spot in the yard and two extra Treasury door posts for E-81; the Hall of 100 Columns column and doorway work spots are generated in sim.ts from the spec.
